title: 10 Questions With Marc Lacey and Carolyn Ryan | The New York Times Company
summary: Our managing editors share their insights on The Times, journalism, New York City pizza and what inspires their work.
body_markdown:
Our managing editors share their insights on The Times, journalism, New York City pizza and what inspires their work.


Since 2022, Marc Lacey and Carolyn Ryan have guided our journalism as the newsroom’s managing editors. In their roles, they’re tasked every day with making our most consequential editorial decisions and leading the more than 2,000 journalists in our newsroom.


But when they’re not leading The New York Times, they are — at times — normal New Yorkers. In the latest installment of “10 Questions with Times Leaders,” we brought them together for a broader conversation, reflecting on their careers, how they approach challenges and what makes them most proud to work at The Times. They also discuss their favorite things about New York City, the pop culture they consume and some of their more surprising skills.
